# Free course lead finder dependencies

Four existing skill blueprints referenced by the high-ticket planning files: caller lead finder, website lead finder, walkthrough lead finder and lead CRM. They were copied from the free course's `skills/leads` folder.

These are application-building instructions with their own assumptions and field names. They are not proof the high-ticket outreach system has a connected list finder. Reuse the useful discovery work after reviewing Places access, permitted data use, quotas, the current member CRM and server-side secret handling. Do not let an older blueprint override the current approved project scope or country/channel requirements.
